name: Woody and Friends
overview: Woody (voice of Tom Hanks) has always been a friendly, streetwise, and aspiring rootin-tootin' Western cowboy whose biggest wish is to think big and become a professional jazz musician. He gets the opportunity to play with a renowned jazz musician but tragically discovers that his destiny is calling out to adventure. Along with the help of Buzz Lightyear (voice of Chris Evans), a fearless and trained laser blade space ranger, Woody must enlist and perform an unexpected personality of his own as he embarks on a mystically impossible journey that summons him beyond anything he could have ever imagined. Determined to prove to the world who he is really meant to be, no matter how big his soul and heart keep growing, your favorite cowboy will take on his most heroic role and set into motion the most emerging adventure ever brought to the big screen.
